description: create-bucket.md correctly restricts the Minimum Durability Level choices by bucket type: its Couchbase Bucket Advanced Settings section offers none, majority, majorityAndPersistActive and persistToMajority, and its Ephemeral Bucket Settings section offers only none and majority. learn/data/durability.md gives the reason - 'You can choose this level only for Couchbase buckets.' edit-bucket.md, which documents editing EITHER type of bucket, lists all four with no qualification: 'The options are **none**, **majority**, **majorityAndPersistActive**, and **persistToMajority**.' The omission is conspicuous because the same page qualifies its neighbours by bucket type where it matters - Ejection Method says 'You can only change this setting for Couchbase buckets', and Database Fragmentation says 'Only settable on Couchbase buckets'. So a reader editing an Ephemeral bucket is told about two durability levels the product will not give them, on a page that is otherwise careful about exactly this distinction.
